shortDescription: Thailand's exports rose 22.3% in July from a year earlier, the central bank said on Monday.Thailand's trade account was in balance in the month, the Bank of Thailand said.Imports rose 35.5% and the current account showed a $1.6 billion deficit in July, the central bank added.

children: Thailand's exports rose 22.3% in July from a year earlier, the central bank said on Monday.
Thailand's trade account was in balance in the month, the Bank of Thailand said.
Imports rose 35.5% and the current account showed a $1.6 billion deficit in July, the central bank added.
